blocks.title: MineXR: Mining Personalized Extended Reality Interfaces
blocks.subtitle: CHI 2024 · Cited by 41

blocks.text: H Cho, Y Yan, K Todi, M Parent, M Smith, TR Jonker, H Benko, D Lindlbauer

blocks.label: Abstract
blocks.text: Extended Reality allows users to customize UIs as they like… We present MineXR, a design mining workflow and data analysis platform for collecting and analyzing personalized XR user interaction and experience data.

blocks.label: 1 Introduction
blocks.text: Extended Reality (XR) devices let users place virtual content anywhere around them. Yet how people would arrange their XR interfaces in everyday contexts remains largely unknown.
